clauses.title: Scope – Gives specifications
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Gives specifications for  chamfered hexagon thin nuts, with thread diameters from M1.6 to M64,including , with product grade A for  threads d ≤ M16 and product grade B for  threads d > M16.

clauses.title: Preferred threads –M1.6, M2,
clauses.text: 2.1 Preferred threads -M1.6, M2, M2.5, M3, M4, M5, M6, M8, M10, M12, M16, M20, M24, M30, M36, M42, M48, M56 and M64

clauses.title: Non–preferred threads – M3.5,
clauses.text: 2.2 Non-preferred threads - M3.5, M14, M18, M22, M2.7, M33, M39, M45, M52, M60 Note - For  details,  on preferred and non -preferred sizes refer to Tables 1 and 2 of the  standard.
